purpose: Describe trying to act or being just about to begin.
keywords: I tried to open the door, but it was locked.
The phone rang just as I was about to leave home.
The cat is trying to climb onto the shelf.
restrictions: With intentional verbs it often means attempt; context can place an event just before its start.
mistake: This construction describes an attempt, not necessarily a successful result.

segments.role: Describe trying to act or being just about to begin. Verb volitional form + とする
